tasks.title: Phase 10 plan approved
tasks.note: Approved by the owner 2026-11-12 (commit 9f9282a). P2 corrected the same day: one tenant per deployment, shared ClickHouse.

tasks.title: M1 Console scope and tenant context
tasks.note: Done 2026-11-12: review rounds 1 (8 findings) and 2 (4) fixed, confirmation round clean. Fixed Grafana reading every tenant (ClickHouse row policies, fail-closed access.xml, clickhouse-access service) and search answering for another tenant's trace ID. Tests: TelemetryApiTests 20/20, verify.sh, tenant.mjs + self-test, inventory.mjs. Trace-ID index gap accepted by the owner. docs/phase-10-console.md

tasks.title: M2 Scale harness
tasks.note: Done 2026-11-12: harness in deploy/local/scale/ (generator 10 services x 10 instances OTLP protobuf; juice-scale stack with 50 rules, 50 SLOs, webhook sink; query mix; sampler; report). Review rounds 1 (16) and 2 (10) and a confirmation round (4, then re-confirmed). Owner: queue lag = past each worker's configured delay. Final 1x smoke run met every target, matches Phase 4 (docs/scale-tests.md). Finding for M3: search cost grows with data in the last hour; disk ~1 TB at full retention (upper bound).

tasks.title: M3 Scale tests 1x/3x/5x/10x
tasks.note: Done 2026-11-13 after review rounds 1, 2, confirmation and re-confirmation. 1x met every §9 target; 3x crossed the SLO-lag line once (64 s vs 60 s; no SLO pass ~60 s; cause not measured, ClickHouse contention likelier). 5x/10x moved to the Phase 11 baseline (owner, 13 Nov). Resource/disk table: 987 GB (1x) / 3,019 GB (3x) table data at full retention.

tasks.title: M4 Drills: upgrade, retention, restore, DR
tasks.note: Can start after M2. Upgrade 1.1.0→1.2.0 with 1x data; retention with short TTLs + disk budget; restore on a fresh compose project; DR RPO ≤ 24 h, RTO ≤ 4 h.

tasks.title: Phase 11 plan: platform self-observability, capacity and performance
tasks.note: Approved 2026-11-13 (revision 2, owner-edited). Revision 3 the same day: rest of the phase toward Collector/ClickHouse/PostgreSQL throughput; component ceilings (R19), ingest tuning (R12a), PostgreSQL (R12b); Overview moved after the fixes. Milestones 1-7.

tasks.title: M1 Self-metrics (R1-R5)
tasks.note: Done 2026-11-13 after review rounds 1, 2 and a clean confirmation round. Own MeterProvider exporting to the Collector platform pipeline (otlp/platform :4319, own token, reserved tenant juice-platform) + Collector self-scrape; allowlist; worker passes/lease; ClickHouse per-caller timing (timeout vs canceled); sampler (PG, ClickHouse via platform_monitor). Tests 677 pass; verify.sh platform checks 14/14 (one older check needs app traffic). As-built deviations on R2/R5 noted in the plan for the gate.

tasks.title: M2 Heartbeats and /health/platform (R6-R7)
tasks.note: Built and reviewed 2026-11-13 (round 1, round 2, confirmation, two re-checks; last findings low and fixed). worker_heartbeats (every known worker per replica, DB time), status states ok/starting/handing_over/off/stale/stuck/unheld/gone, /health/platform (anonymous, 503 when degraded), /api/v1/platform/status (operators of this tenant). Tests 707 pass. Committed; the ClickHouse-stop drill waits for owner permission, then done.

tasks.title: M3 Baseline steps 1x/3x/5x/10x, per component (R14)
tasks.note: Fresh scale stack (needs owner permission to stop the working stack). Collector in/out/refused and queue; ClickHouse insert rate, parts, CPU, query time by caller; PostgreSQL tx, connections, outbox age.

tasks.title: M4 Component ceilings: ingest, ClickHouse queries, workers, PostgreSQL (R19)
tasks.note: Each component pushed on its own until a line is crossed; generator sent rate checked against its target.

tasks.title: M5 Fixes: ingest path, ClickHouse isolation, queries, PostgreSQL if needed (R11, R12, R12a, R12b)
tasks.note: One change at a time, before and after; final rerun with held-out 4x/6x for the ±25 % check.

tasks.title: M6 Overview platform panel and capacity view (R8-R9)
tasks.note: Built from the final rerun and the ceilings (not provisional).

architecturePageUpdates: Title says 'through Phase 6, 7 Nov 2026': Phases 7–9 are done and released in 1.2.0, Phase 10 in progress.
Build status colours: phases 5–9 done (accepted 2026-11-11/12); 10 in progress.
Pending work list is stale: Phase 5–6 review done; Slack and TLS mail tried 2026-11-12 (Teams not yet); a test-send button exists (commit f923a42).
Add Phases 7–9: Juice Agent enrollment and diagnostics, approved actions and remediation, SLOs and burn-rate alerts, correlation suggestions.
Grafana: user grafana_reader now limited to the deployment's tenant by ClickHouse row policy grafana_tenant (after 1.2.0; Phase 10 M1).
Grafana tenant boundary: row policies fail closed (access.xml); trace-ID index visible across tenants, accepted by the owner 2026-11-12.
Phase 10 M2: scale harness (deploy/local/scale/) and a 1x run meeting every §9 target with 10 services x 100 instances, 50 rules, 50 SLOs.
Phase 10 M3: 1x holds every target; first limit at 3x is SLO counting under ClickHouse contention; ClickHouse is the CPU (2.65 vCPU at 1x); disk ~1 TB at full retention at 1x, ~3 TB at 3x.
Phase 11 (planned 2026-11-13): platform self-observability, Overview platform panel and capacity estimate, ClickHouse workload isolation; Phase 10 M4-M5 wait for it.
Roadmap trigger table: new row for a ClickHouse replica or sharding (2026-11-13); Phase 11 runs before Phase 10 M4-M5 by owner exception.
Phase 11 M1: platform self-metrics exported under reserved tenant juice-platform (Collector platform pipeline :4319, own token); ClickHouse user platform_monitor; docs/platform-metrics.md.
Phase 11 M2: worker heartbeats in PostgreSQL; /health/platform (alerting probes, not liveness/readiness) and /api/v1/platform/status (operators).

Phase 11 revision 3 (2026-11-13): focus on Collector/ClickHouse/PostgreSQL throughput; milestones now 1 self-metrics, 2 heartbeats, 3 baseline, 4 component ceilings, 5 fixes, 6 Overview, 7 guide/release.
